_doc: Phase 2 (October 2026) revenue ledger. Starts at ¥0 on 2026-10-01 00:00 JST. Only third-party revenue dated 2026-10-01..2026-10-31 (Asia/Tokyo) is booked here; September stays in status/revenue_ledger.json (frozen). Writers: sales monitors (Stripe/Gumroad via scripts/lib/periods.mjs) and operators for channels without an API (Coconala/BOOTH/note/Zenn/Etsy) via `node scripts/oct/ops.mjs revenue ...`. Gross Revenue = sum of jpy_equivalent over entries with third_party!=false and is_test!=true. Never book self-purchases, tests, unpaid orders or clicks.

entry_schema.gross: amount in original currency (what the buyer paid, before platform fee)
entry_schema.jpy_equivalent: number (USD at 150 JPY unless provider payout says otherwise)
entry_schema.source: stripe | gumroad | coconala | booth | etsy | note | zenn | ...
entry_schema.reference: provider order/charge id (no PII, no secrets) — dedup key
entry_schema.verified: true only when confirmed on the provider side
entry_schema.hypothesis: optional hypothesis id from STATE.json that produced it (attribution)
